Fewer homes on the market than a year ago, but fewer buyers too. TRREB reports 26,131 active listings across the GTA in September 2026 (down 9.3% from September 2025), with sales down 9.0%. Local conditions vary a lot by neighbourhood and home type. Want the numbers for your street? DM me "MARKET" or call 905-452-4298.

Source: TRREB Market Watch, September 2026.

Canada housing check-in. CREA reports August 2026 home sales down 0.7% from July, the MLS Home Price Index down 3.0% from a year earlier (the smallest yearly decline since October 2025), and 4.8 months of inventory nationally. Your local market may look different. DM me "MARKET" or call 905-452-4298.

The down payment is not the only cheque you write. Save this closing cost checklist: land transfer tax, legal fees, title insurance, adjustments and home insurance. Costs vary by purchase, so ask your lawyer for an estimate. Questions? DM me "COSTS" or call 905-452-4298.

Saving for a first home? Three FHSA numbers: $8,000 annual limit, unused room carries forward (up to $8,000), $40,000 lifetime limit. Contributions are generally deductible and qualifying withdrawals are tax-free. Eligibility rules apply, so check the CRA site and talk to your tax or mortgage professional. Not tax, mortgage or legal advice. DM me "FHSA" or call 905-452-4298.

Source: Canada Revenue Agency.

What is happening with new homes in the GTA? BILD reports 907 new home sales in August 2026: up significantly from the record low of August 2025, but 37% below the 10-year average. Condo apartments: 215 sales (up 50% from August 2025). Single-family: 692. Inventory: 19,030 units, about 38.5 months of supply. DM me "NEWHOME" or call 905-452-4298.

Source: BILD / Altus Group, August 2026 (released Sept 22, 2026).
